decisions.reason: The owner asked on the same day that each type of task have its model set in the config, and the roadmap lists the choice as deferred work, not as barred; the plan records the difference and leaves any roadmap change to the owner.
The owner chose cards by command for now; the plan now states the difference from the spec, lists filing-time cards as deferred, and leaves any spec change to the owner.
The title, outline and notes are also untrusted inputs to the card job, so each now gets a labelled section with a per-call token, and the tests use hostile versions of each.
Checked the card spec: English output and a size cutoff set by a setting are agreed behaviors, so the prompt asks for English and a cutoff setting sends small items to a card with no model call.
A command line option naming a registry entry goes against the spec and against the per task settings, so it is removed and the owner edits the task setting instead.
